name: Maker's Terrace
summary: At the Badlands' northern edge, Dark Iron dwarves hold the Maker's Terrace beside the pass from Loch Modan. Their open-air dig guards the way into Uldaman.

sections.title: Threshold of the Vault
sections.body: From the pass out of Loch Modan, you cross trenches and scaffolds spread across the northern Badlands. The dig fronts Uldaman's entrance, an ancient vault built by the Makers. Travelers cross this exposed ground before reaching the halls below. Rival factions contest the approach as they seek a way into the ruins.

sections.title: Dark Iron Occupation
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves patrol the ditches and perimeter, keeping outsiders from the dig. They seek the Makers' relics and power to dominate what lies beneath the earth. Their crews search the hillside for armaments, records, and other relics left by the ancient Makers. The sentries guard the route into Uldaman, and travelers who try to pass meet a hostile welcome.

faq.q: Where is the Maker's Terrace located?
faq.answer: The Maker's Terrace lies in the far north of the Badlands beside the pass from Loch Modan. Its excavation surrounds Uldaman's outer entrance.
Hostile Dark Iron dwarves occupy and patrol the Maker's Terrace. They dig into the hillside and guard the approach to Uldaman.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the excavation?
aliases: what are dark irons looking for
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves excavate Uldaman, an ancient titan complex, seeking relics and power over its depths. They search its vaults for machinery and secrets before rival factions can claim them.

faq.q: Is Maker's Terrace part of Uldaman?
faq.answer: Yes. The Maker's Terrace is the open-air excavation outside Uldaman, leading to its halls and caves.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you may resent the treacherous Dark Iron clan's hold on the Maker's Terrace. Uldaman holds the deepest secrets of dwarven origins.
As a miner, you can see heavy ore workings in the quarries and earthworks cut into the sandstone cliffs.
